description: $0.05 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one full agent-readiness audit report for one submitted URL: the verdict line and score under the published criteria, per-criterion status with evidence from the fetched documents, and a concrete fix list of additive machine surfaces. Pass criteria_version "agent-readiness/v2" to run the audit under the criteria v2 rulebook instead (same $0.05 price). Fetched page content is processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the URL. It does not certify the business, its safety, or its honesty.

criteria_version.description: Optional. "agent-readiness/v2" runs the audit under the criteria v2 rulebook (GET /toll/readiness/criteria/v2); omit it for the default agent-readiness/v1. Same $0.05 price.

url.description: The page to audit — its public http/https URL. Submit only URLs of sites you operate or are authorized to audit.

name: readiness_audit
